sources.title: nemotron-3-embed-1b Model by NVIDIA | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: nvidia/nemotron-3-embed-1b operates in `passage` or `query` mode, and thus requires the `input_type` parameter. `passage` is used when generating embeddings during indexing. `query` is used when generating embeddings during querying. It is very important to use the correct `input_type`.
